facts.fact: ARCT's 2024 ICT indicators report lists BBS (Burundi Backbone System) as a fibre infrastructure operator with 1,750 km of fibre deployed at 31 December 2024, covering all provinces.
ARCT states BBS's fibre (1,750 km) covers all provinces of Burundi and that the national territory is now covered by fibre optic, as at 31 December 2024.

note: Report gives no access terms; Viettel 3,400 km has no stated coverage (table extraction fragmented), so no fact for it; ONATEL 350 km is metro (Bujumbura).
